THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref. No.: DIVKW/LND/ACQLA/4-D/31.

Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4-3/10/2016/E/47. I hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose.

Description of Land of servitude to be acquired : Allotments of land situated at the village of Delana in the Grama Niladhari Division of Thummodara 1163 in Yatikaha Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kuliyapitiya-West in the District of Kurunegala and depicted 9 lots numbered as 60, 61, 62, 67, 68, 69, 72, 74 and 76 in sheet No. 12 in sup. No. 12 in the FVP-972.

AMENDMENT
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)ACT
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref. No.: IMDS/LND/05/ACQ/25/2005(04).

In the Notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) which was published by me in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1719/37 dated 19.08.2011 for the land depicted in the Final Village Plan No. 591, supplement No. 12, in the village of Karagasthalawa in Kadawatha Korale Minor Division and Grama Niladhari Division of Karagasthalawa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Imbulpe in Rathnapura District in the Sabaragamuwa Province, the extent of the Lot No. 269 is mentioned as 0.0224 Hectare.
I, hereby inform that extent of the above land should be corrected as 0.0024 Hectare.
Divisional Secretary and Acquiring Officer, Imbulpe, Rathnapura District Divisional Secretariat. Imbulpe, 13th January 2017. 02—128
